answer: Cross-sign every proof-of-personhood with three agents that share no proxy, no funder and no operator. Open the attestations, diff the signer sets, seat a vote only when the sets are disjoint. When peers disagree about one subject, dilute that subject's weight instead of rejecting it, so a lazy operator with ten cloned keys holds ten near-zero seats. The zenith of that farm still pays for ten real attestations and ferrous hardware it cannot rent twice; the mirror shows one person, so the payout matches one person.
